In detail

This barri has a documented pattern of property crime against both residents and tourists. In April 2026 two men attempted to snatch a tourist family's bag at Plaça Willy Brandt (the Fòrum area); the attempt failed and was caught on dashcam. A June 2026 'ram-raid' smashed a luxury car into a jewellery store in the Diagonal Mar shopping centre at night. A city councillor documented building-entrance robberies, car break-ins, thefts and heavy drug-paraphernalia presence in Diagonal Mar park. No reports of violent crime against persons were found — the concern is theft/robbery of property, including opportunistic targeting of tourists. Sources checked: Metrópoli Abierta, 6 Apr 2026 / 15 Jun 2026 / 15 Oct 2024.
